item.title: Maven in 5 Minutes
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Maven in 5 Minutes
Apache Maven’s own quick start: with Java and Maven installed, create a first project with mvn archetype:generate, build it with mvn package and learn the build lifecycle phases.
https://maven.apache.org/guides/getting-started/maven-in-five-minutes.html
Default lifecycle phases:

  • validate: validate the project is correct and all necessary information is available
  • compile: compile the source code of the project
  • test: test the compiled source code using a suitable unit testing framework. These tests should not require the code be packaged or deployed
  • package: take the compiled code and package it in its distributable format, such as a JAR
  • integration-test: process and deploy the package if necessary into an environment where integration tests can be run
  • verify: run any checks to verify the package is valid and meets quality criteria
  • install: install the package into the local repository, for use as a dependency in other projects locally
  • deploy: done in an integration or release environment, copies the final package to the remote repository for sharing with other developers and projects
